cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Give It Up
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender something they value.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No need to put me in charge. Would you sell your signed guitar so we can replace the fridge?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I queued all night for that signature.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm merely helping this reach the right outcome. Then let's price it properly. Those hours should buy us an ice maker.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll sell the case. The guitar stays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep the case. You can still tell the queue story while I photograph the guitar.

confusable: Not neutral assistance selling what B chose: A substitutes its guitar-sale plan for B proposed case-only concession.
comparison: Medal status preserved publicly versus guitar memory preserved in its case.
